_about: Client data for Projeto Luan (not code). Pasted into Projeto → Sistema → Configuração inicial on an empty spreadsheet. Keys of `config` are the Config keys of spec §3.2; dates are yyyy-mm-dd. The plan (Push/Pull/Legs A/B) is not in this file: paste clients/luan_exercicios.tsv into Exercícios and clients/luan_ficha.tsv into Ficha de treino, then Salvar nova ficha.
_decisions: client.startDate = 2026-10-28, the day the spreadsheet is created (no earlier records are migrated).

The plan is the same Push A → Legs B used in Zoio's F002 (Luan wrote it from his own training): 1 aquecimento + 1 reconhecimento (feeder) + 2 work sets of 6–10 reps at 0–1 RIR; only the work sets count.
Objective 'deficit' (cutting leve): target −0.25 to −0.75 %/week instead of the rule default −0.5 to −1.0, to preserve lean mass on the way to ~12% body fat.
TMB Mifflin = 10·85.3 + 6.25·182 − 5·26 + 5 = 1865.5 kcal; with activityFactor 1.6 the TDEE is ~2985 kcal, so 2500 kcal is a ~16% deficit.
Carbohydrate = (2500 − 4·185 − 9·70) / 4 = 282.5 g, recomputed by the script.
routine.cardioPerWeek = 3 (minimum stated; duration not defined yet). stepsPerDay = 10000 ≈ 8 km/day walking at a ~0.76 m stride.

config.client.name: Luan
config.client.notes: Método: 1 aquecimento + 1 série de reconhecimento + 2 work sets (só as work sets contam no volume). Caminhada ~8 km/dia em ladeiras (ida e volta da faculdade, Florianópolis). Cardio ≥3x/semana, duração a definir. Acompanhamento de BF por fotos. Almoço e jantar no RU.
config.routine.sessionRotation: Push A, Pull A, Legs A, Push B, Pull B, Legs B

objectives.name: Cutting leve
objectives.expectation: Preservar o máximo de massa magra e chegar a ~12% de gordura corporal, acompanhando fotos, cintura e desempenho

goals.reason: Cutting leve: ~15% abaixo do gasto estimado; proteína ~2,2 g/kg para preservar massa magra.

review.message: Fator de atividade 1,6 é uma estimativa (5 treinos + 3 cardios + ~8 km/dia de caminhada); revisar com 2–3 semanas de peso e ingestão.
